data.one_liner: Dart implementation of gRPC, a high performance universal RPC framework.
data.what_it_does: Provides client and server implementations for gRPC in Dart and Flutter. It allows communication using HTTP/2 and Protocol Buffers, with support for gRPC-Web.
use_when: You need high-performance communication between microservices or client and server using gRPC.
Your backend services are already using gRPC and Protocol Buffers.
avoid_when: Your backend is built around a standard REST/JSON API.
You want a lightweight HTTP client without the overhead of Protocol Buffers and gRPC setup.
strengths: High performance and efficient binary serialization via Protocol Buffers.
Supports both Dart native and Flutter across multiple platforms.
Includes support for gRPC-Web and Unix Domain Sockets.
weaknesses: Requires managing Protocol Buffer definitions and code generation.
Steeper learning curve compared to standard REST clients.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up Protocol Buffer definitions and compilation tools to generate Dart stubs.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are communicating with a traditional REST/JSON API instead of gRPC.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a basic HTTP client without gRPC overhead.
